tools.name: fm_inspect_log
tools.description: Free flight-log parser for ArduPilot .bin, PX4 .ulog, Betaflight/INAV .bbl, or JSON telemetry returning sample counts, duration, sample rate, dropouts, events, and parameters.

tools.name: fm_power_health
tools.description: Free battery & propulsion health analyzer computing auto cell count (1S-12S), sag, OLS internal resistance R_int (mOhm + R^2), trapezoidal mAh/Wh, hover throttle, and motor imbalance/saturation.

tools.name: fm_fft_spectrum
tools.description: Free Cooley-Tukey Welch Hann-windowed gyro/accel PSD analyzer returning parabolic sub-bin peaks, SNR, harmonic combs, and biquad notch/LPF filter targets.

tools.name: fm_crash_diagnose
tools.description: Free flight crash forensics engine ranking 8 physical failure causes (motor loss, brownout, EKF divergence, vibration clipping, PID oscillation, attitude loss, dropout, failsafe) into a <= 20 KB fingerprint.

tools.name: fm_tune_diff
tools.description: Metered ($0.015) bounds-clamped, <=25%-step PID and notch/LPF parameter diff synthesizer for ArduPilot, PX4, Betaflight, and INAV with apply and atomic rollback manifests.

tools.name: fm_compare_flights
tools.description: Metered ($0.010) before/after A/B flight regression comparator reporting noise dB change, attitude RMS delta, vibration delta, motor imbalance, and battery sag deltas.
